children: A new White House task force will produce a report on the risks posed by artificial intelligence and what responsibility the US federal government should have over the technology, according to Bloomberg. Bloomberg reported the Wall Street Journal said the group will examine both the risks and the federal government's role in overseeing AI.

title: AI Task Force to Assess Risks, Federal Oversight, WSJ Says
